feedback.finish: Predators have adaptations that help them find, catch and kill their prey. Most predators have good eyesight, are fast and have features like claws or sharp teeth.

instruction.text: Find the adaptations that help the tiger to kill its prey.

feedback.end: Tigers have big, sharp teeth and strong jaws that help them catch and tear apart their prey.
Good hearing and good eyesight help tigers to find their prey when they hunt at night.
Tigers’ stripes help them to camouflage. This means they can sneak up on their prey without being noticed.

instruction.text: Drag the adaptations to the lion.
Match the adaptation to how it helps the lion.

atoms.b: to run fast and catch prey
to spot and hunt prey, especially at night
to protect the neck during fights

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Animals are not the only predators: some plants are too! Venus fly traps cannot get enough nutrients from the soil in their habitat, so they adapted to eat insects. In order to attract these insects, they are colourful and produce a sweet-smelling nectar.

Venus fly traps have small hairs that allow them to sense when an insect has landed on them. Once they detect an insect, their long teeth lace together and trap the insect so it cannot escape. Then, they squash and digest the insect.

atoms.a: Why do venus fly traps eat insects?
b: ++to get nutrients they cannot get from soil

atoms.a: How do venus fly traps attract insects?

hint.text: More than one answer can be correct.

atoms.a: How do venus fly traps catch their prey?
b: ++their leaves close tight to squash the insect

hint.text: More than one answer can be correct.
